title: EU battery recycling plant tracker: capacity announcements 2024-2026
text: Announced EU pre-treatment capacity (shredding to black mass) rose from about 310,000 tonnes per year in early 2024 to about 520,000 tonnes in 2026, while hydrometallurgical refining capacity stayed far smaller, at roughly 140,000 tonnes. Two of the eleven projects we tracked were paused in 2025 after metal prices fell. Utilisation of operating plants averaged under 50% in 2025 because end-of-life EV packs remain scarce; most feedstock is scrap from cell factories.
